college_info.intro:
The flagship courses offered at PSIT Kanpur are BTech MBA, and MTech among others. Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology offers courses at more than 15 levels, including undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes. Moreover, it offers these programmes in the stream of Engineering, Business Management and Computer Application. The most popular course offered at PSIT Kanpur is BTech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), CSE (Artificial Intelligence), CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), CSE (Data Science), CS (Hindi), Information Technology, and Electronics & Communication Engineering. fees_and_eligibility.overview: The modes of PSIT Kanpur course admissions 2025 are online and offline. Admissions are based on merit and entrance exam scores. At the UG level, the college offers three to four-year BTech and BPharma courses to students. BTech is offered in 10 specialisations. At the PG level, PSIT Kanpur offers two-year MTech, MCA, MBA, and MPharma courses to students. BBA and BCA are offered through PSIT College of Higher Education in affiliation with the Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur. Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology also provides diploma and other courses to students. Below mentioned are some of the and their respective eligibility and fees:

faqs.answer: A:    Once all of the rounds of the selection process are done, selected students are required to pay the fees to secure their admission. As per the official website, the fee to pursue DPharma at PSIT Kanpur is INR 45,000 per annum. Students can pay the fee in online mode via net banking/credit card/debit card.Note: The above-mentioned fee is as per the official sources. However, it is indicative and subject to change.
faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for DPharma programme at PSIT Kanpur?

faqs.answer: A:    The total annual fees of BCA is INR 2.40 lakh. Candidates are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. In case, a candidate is unable to pay the fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Aspirants will also need to pay a registration fee to apply for admission.

reviews_list.review_title: Average placement but better than other private colleges.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 50 to 60% of students get placement every year. The average placement is about 5 to 6 LPA, and the highest package is 64 LPA (off-campus). paragraphs: Pranveer Singh Institute of Technology (PSIT) admission 2025is both merit and entrance-based. Class 12 with PCM with at least 60% aggregate from a recognised board
JEE Main/CUET UG+ Aptitude Test + PI
Graduation along with Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 60% aggregate or above from a recognised university

paragraphs: PSIT placements are going on for the Class of 2025. As of now, Microsoft has offered the highest package of INR 51 LPA during the PSIT Kanpur placements 2025. Over 300 recruiters visited the PSIT campus in 2025 and presented over 2640 job offers to the students of the 2025 batch. HCLTech selected the highest number of students and the count stood at 218. The top recruiters of PSIT Kanpur in 2025 included TCS, Google, Microsoft, HCLTech, Cognizant, Amazon, Intellipaat, etc.

Earlier, more than 300 companies visited the campus and offered 2163 job offers during the PSIT Kanpur placement 2023. TCS selected the highest number of students and the count stood at 214. Further, 171 students received a minimum of 3 job offers in 2024. The highest package offered during PSIT Kanpur placements 2024 was INR 47.88 LPA. The list of recruiters included Tiger Analytics, Groww, Capgemini, MAQ Software, and many others.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied according to the placement scenario and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure and facilities the classrooms and overall labs and academic place are satisfactory. The facilities in the hostel are not worth it except for the food they provide. The rules and regulations lead to unbearable circumstances and hence, overall we will rate on a scale of 10 as 5.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement but better than other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure and hostel facilities, but management is very strict, and fines are normal in college. Food quality is average, Only vegetarian food is available in the mess, but you can order from outside the campus with your money, and you can eat. A medical facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with 90 percent attendance and a fine curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent as AC classrooms are provided, and a library facility is also available. The quality of food is good, but there is less variety. The campus crowd is diverse, and the curriculum also includes hands-on projects, industry tools, and real-world case studies.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is very good, and the infrastructure is really good.
reviews.review_text: There is a broad class, so high-speed internet is available. Labs and classrooms are very clean, which creates a good environment to study. There are sports events at regular intervals. Library facilities are amazing. They provide a very quiet environment for better focus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by PSIT College of Higher EducationReviewed on 26 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and it is safe to live in the hostel.
reviews.review_text: A LAN cable is used to access the internet. It is very disappointing for me as it is too old technology compared to today’s fast-moving world. It should be replaced with Wi-Fi. Labs are above average compared to other colleges. Library books should be updated according to the time.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is doing great.
reviews.review_text: It is quite vast and has all facilities we need. There is cleanliness as well as plants. Sanitation areas are well-maintained. Labs are quite peaceful and managed. The infrastructure is just great. There are cafeterias, parking areas, open and closed gyms for both boys and girls, and a great mess as well.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and the infrastructure are good. Faculty is nice and supportive.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus, and labs are good. The library is also good. Classrooms are bring-your-own-device, so students bring their own devices and work on them. Mess and canteen food are very edible. Sports and games are organized by clubs on time. A dispensary is also available.

reviews.review_heading: The campus and facilities are good, but the teaching quality & practical exposure need improvement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, but if you want to play any sport, it is not suitable because sports are not allowed. Class timings are very strict, and we cannot change them. The hostel is good, with every room equipped with AC. The mess is also good. Classrooms are clean and equipped with air conditioning. Wi-Fi is not available, so LAN is used for wired internet.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally dissatisfied by their late entry timing.
reviews.review_text: If we talk about infrastructure, it's excellent. All the necessary facilities are available in the campus. All the classes are fully air conditioning, library is available. But there is no Wi-Fi campus; only lawns are available for internet, and also in my college lots of issues of network.

reviews.review_heading: It is value for money and quite good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are quite good, but there is a huge issue with the internet and LAN connections. The classrooms are neat, but the internet does not work properly, and even in BYOD classes the network is poor. Overall, facilities in the hostel are good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but so many restrictions.
reviews.review_text: LAN is available most of the time you're in college. Labs are furnished well. The library does have all the books you would generally need for your course-related curriculum. I'm not a hostler, but I've heard from friends that the food in the mess is just about okay or even not good at times. A sports event is organized each year.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the infrastructure and college.
reviews.review_text: I'm residing in a hostel, and the infrastructure is really very good. The hostel facilities at PSIT are overall quite good, especially if you are looking for a disciplined and comfortable living environment. Rooms are well-maintained, cleaned regularly, and the overall campus feels very safe due to tight security and clear rules. The atmosphere is peaceful, which helps a lot during exam time. The mess food is decent. Not perfect every day, but hygienic and better than what many colleges offer. T...

reviews.review_heading: Good campus, average job.
reviews.review_text: PSIT offers AC classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and a large digital library. Hostels are clean with AC/non-AC rooms, good mess food, medical care, and strong sports facilities. Overall, the campus provides a comfortable and study-friendly environment.

reviews.review_heading: Shiny infrastructure, average teaching, and limited internships. PSIT needs depth beyond placements.
reviews.review_text: PSIR Kanpur offers AC labs, smart classrooms, and a decent library, but the Wi-Fi is limited to 2GB/day. Hostels are basic, and the mess food is average and repetitive. Sports infrastructure exists but lacks culture. Medical aid is minimal. Facilities look good, but the depth is missing.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very strict.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, but if you want to play any sport, then do not come because they do not let us play anything. Class timings are very crucial, and we cannot do anything about them. Hostel rules are good. Each one is equipped with AC, and the mess is also decent. Classes and labs are clean and equipped with air conditioning. Wi-Fi is not present. We just use the LAN for wired internet.

reviews.review_heading: The overall campus environment is good and the campus is located in a very peaceful area.
reviews.review_text: The food quality and indoor infrastructure are really good. The room maintenance is also good. There are 3 people in a room for boys and 4 in a room for girls. Also, the food here is unlimited and available every day. The only problem is with the hot water.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with good facilities.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi both in the hostel and on the campus. The quality of food is pretty good as they follow a particular list of food items that are prepared every day. The hostel is clean as they clean the rooms and bathrooms every day except for Sunday, and there are washing machines too. There are sports teams selected through the selection process.

reviews.review_heading: Bad placement record for year 2024 passouts.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are okay, but during gloomy days the lighting is not enough. But lab conditions are very bad. Nothing works properly in analog and digital lab. Our communication lab is straight from 19th century, you can hardly find a set of working components. The voltage regulators are broken, they keep fluctuating, and the signal/frequency generators. They cannot generate a signal in the millivolt range, yet you are expected to get output.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements, and a good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at the college is good, and the hostel is also good according to many students who time me, but the good is not that great, and the rest of the things in and from the college are good, and they are still trying to improve all the left out mistakes.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college with good infrastructure and a good student body.
reviews.review_text: Campus on Kanakapura Road is a bit far from the city. It's not huge, but it's not very small either, it has a decent capacity with specific blocks for particular courses, equipped with labs and lecture halls. The infrastructure is satisfactory for students to study in this college, but you can't expect it to meet every need.

reviews.review_heading: A modern infrastructure campus for its area, with decent placements and friendly lecturers.
reviews.review_text: DSATM is a 10-acre campus with modern infrastructure, especially the architecture block. It is a green campus powered by solar energy. The library, gym, and activity center are available. The canteen has recently been upgraded to include non-vegetarian options. The hostel is very near to the college, offering good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good with all facilities and a good environment. It has good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel facility for both boys and girls with Wi-Fi. It has a well-maintained environment. The library is good. Separate sections are maintained in each course. A digital library is also available. Students can use a computer available in the library for their study purposes.

reviews.review_heading: I am experiencing good education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and they have a good canteen as well, offering a variety of food.

reviews.review_heading: There are good placements.
reviews.review_text: There are very good facilities and infrastructure in DSATM, with a huge and good lab in DSATM college,  having a good hostel facility, and a clean mess. The food quality is average and not worth for money, and the hostel fee is high and not worth for money.

reviews.review_heading: Fascinating about placements this year 2025
reviews.review_text: Every classroom and lab has a projector. There are no benches. Only wheel chairs are there for students. There are 3 Wi-Fi connections for every building. The speed is moderate. The library is also very good. It has all kinds of books. To be frank, the hostel and canteen food is not good. The sports facility is limited even the gym. Medical facilities are provided in every building.

reviews.review_heading: A honest review of our college.
reviews.review_text: Campus of our college is amazing. It consists of 10 acres. It's all about greenery and good without areas. Our hostel is very good and it has good food and mess. There is good Wi-Fi connection in college at every part and we have amphitheatre too.

reviews.review_heading: The college I know and the best I have known. It has good faculty members and education.
reviews.review_text: Classes are very good with ventilation and projectors needed for interactive learning. Classrooms are more and occupy the space for all students. Labs are also available for every department with well-equipped computer systems and applications. The Wi-Fi availability is throughout the campus but may vary in some places. The quality of the hotel and its facilities, food, and maintenance is average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dayananda Sagar Academy Of Technology And Management (DSATM).
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure includes well-designed benches with ample seating. However, there are some old buildings. The Wi-Fi connectivity could be improved in certain areas to fully support the needs of students requiring high-bandwidth access for research and ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college to do engineering.
reviews.review_text: There are mainly 4 blocks A, B, C, and M, all stand differently from each other. Hostel is very clean and both South and North Indian food will be provided. The course is best like CSE. CSE-related branches are very helpful for the students and they help in placements also.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college infrastructure, faculty, and facilities provided to students.
reviews.review_text: So, the facility of a library is available where you will find each and every book related to your course. Classrooms are digital, having projectors, and teachers utilize those for teaching. I am not in a hostel of my college, but I have heard that food is average. The food available in the canteen is of the best quality, as we usually go there for lunch. Indoor games such as table tennis, chess, and carrom are available.

faqs.question: Does FET MRIIRS accept JEE score?
faqs.answer: Yes, FET MRIIRS does accept JEE Main scores for admission to B.Tech programs along with other exams like MRNAT, SAT India, and Uni-GAUGE.Adding more to this a valid JEE Main score is mandatory for admission to most B.Tech programs at FET MRIIRS and as well many other colleges in India. The weightage given to JEE Main scores in the selection process varies depending on the programme and year. You can find the specific weightage for each programme on the FET MRIIRS website.The best part is that the institute has no minimum percentile score required for all the B.Tech Programs, but also one thing to know here is that the cut-off scores for each programme vary.

reviews.review_heading: A solid college choice with updated labs, internship opportunities, and improved placement.
reviews.review_text: Our department provides well-maintained infrastructure and facilities to support academic and practical learning. There is also a sports arena where there is a coach of boxing, shooting and many sports instruments. Wi-fi is also available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna campus placement review
reviews.review_text: The department offers good infrastructure, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped civil engineering labs, and an updated library with relevant books and journals. The hostels provide clean rooms and essential amenities, and the mess offers decent-quality food with a variety of options.

reviews.review_heading: My learnings during the four years of engineering at Manav Rachna.
reviews.review_text: The labs in our department had good working equipment where practicals could be performed easily. The college library was excellent, having all varieties of books for any branch. I didn't have any problems in searching for books in the library. The library has full Wi-Fi and is air-conditioned. Classrooms were normal, having air conditioning facilities. I didn't stay at the hostel; therefore, I didn't have much idea about it.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced learning environment with strong labs and good placement.
reviews.review_text: MRIIRS has smart classrooms. The labs are quite well-equipped for civil engineering. Especially, we have labs like the survey lab, structure lab, concrete technology lab, soil mechanics lab, and fluid mechanics lab. There is a central library for both digital and physical resources.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of all facilities.
reviews.review_text: MRIIRS has very good infrastructure. The classrooms are clean and air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped, and the library has a great study environment. Civil Engineering labs like Surveying, Concrete Technology, Environmental, Geotechnical, and Structures are modern and provide hands-on learning. The campus is green, well-maintained, and has strong Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and good canteens.

Labs and classrooms are very well maintained. A gym is available on the campus. We have huge Libraries. Classrooms have smart boards. Computer labs are well maintained. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna University goes beyond academics to focus on the holistic development of its students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College Review of DAVIET Jalandhar by a 1st Year Student.

content.Placements: The majority of the students were placed from the college, with the highest package of about 70 LPA. Companies like Wipro, Microsoft, L&T, and many others. In college, each student is made industry-ready, and proper training is given so that each and every student gets a better placement.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are great, and the infrastructure is not the best, but it's great. Wi-Fi doesn't work that well. Besides the library is amazing. It has plenty of study material, including books, notes, test papers, newsletters, and many more. Overall, it's great.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Value For Money College with good faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: In our third year, many companies visited our campus for pre-placement offers. About 95% of my batchmates cleared the aptitude test, for which our professors provided extra classes. Unfortunately, many failed in the last round, so only 40-50% of my classmates were actually placed. Luckily, I was one of them. The highest package was 74 lacs, secured by my senior, and the lowest was 3 lacs. The average was 5-6 lacs. The top recruiters were Infosys and ST Microelectronics.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good modern infrastructure, including well-ventilated classrooms and labs with ample PCs and air conditioning. The library is centrally organized and has electronic access as well. The library had many books for static GK and current affairs. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Classrooms are equipped with smartboards and ample charging sockets for laptops and phones. There is an international-level football ground, two basketball courts, and great campus nightlife. The canteen is not that great, but other cheaper and better options are available near the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: DAVIET College review for B.Teach CSE.

content.Placements: Placements are good. Decent students easily get placed. The highest salary package offered in our college is about 70 LPA, and the average salary package offered ranges from 5 LPA - 10 LPA. Internships and training provided in our college are good.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is entirely Wi-Fi operated. So students can easily connect to Wi-Fi anywhere in the college. Classrooms may vary from course to course. Some classrooms are better, and some are not so good. Our college has 2 floors for the library and it is very well managed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, good performance and management .

content.Placements: More than 90% of students are placed every year in reputed companies; the highest package is 15 LPA for freshers, and the average package is 4–7 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, GreyB, etc. 100% of students got internships. The top roles offered in my course are web development and software engineering .
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms, labs, and library management and infrastructure are very good. There is also the availability of Wi-Fi. Classrooms are spacious and in labs there is huge availability of computers. Hostels are also in good condition, and the food provided by the mess is good. My college also has medical facilities; there is a canteen and a sandwich shop in my college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Mediocre college with decent placements.

content.Placements: The placement trend in CSE department is approximately 70-80% students getting placed every year in majority tier 3 companies based in Mohali. Average package this has been 7-8 LPA. A student even got a package of 70 LPA in a USA based company. Mole roles offered are of Software Development Engineer (SDE). Minimum package is around 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are well-equipped with projector screens and sound system in each class. Wi-Fi facility is in the entire campus. The library is the best thing in this college, with good interior, every type of books available and also an e-learning section available. Canteen food is good. Hostel has AC and non-AC rooms, Wi-Fi, medical facility at any time of the day, and a gym as well.

faqs.answer: Yes, VESIT refunds the fee. faqs.question: Can I take admission in VESIT, M.Tech without GATE?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for M.Tech admission at VESIT College, students should have an undergraduate degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate, alongside they must also have either a GATE score or a MHT CET (M.Tech) score. and yes admission without GATE is possible, but a MHT CET M.Tech score is mandatory. The deadline to apply through the MHT CET M.Tech exam is on July 24 2024.  students should ensure they meet these criteria and submit their applications before the specified date to be considered for admission to the M.Tech programme at VESIT College. also not to forget work experience gives an extra advantage to get seat.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just okay. From the outside, it looks decent, but once you step in, the reality hits different. Classrooms feel outdated, like something from the early 2000s, with broken benches making more noise than students. Projectors either don't work or display blurry slides forget about having ACs.

reviews.review_heading: So I’m satisfied with the college, and we are having good placements every year.

reviews.review_heading: Modern infrastructure and student-friendly campus.

Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole college.

reviews.review_heading: Famous and popular college to pursue Engineering.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and college life.
reviews.review_text: The labs are well equipped, with all the systems in working condition. The classrooms are spacious. College Wi-Fi is also available for students. The library is also well equipped with books. The college has a hostel that is located on the campus itself.

reviews.review_heading: A college with one of the best placements in Mumbai.

Apart from that labs are well maintained and library is very good and has a lot of books. Canteen food is very good except few dishes which should be removed from the menu.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are better than expectations. Lots of opportunities are available.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, Classrooms, Smart classroom, Library, Gymkhana, Elevators and also other amenities. Hostel rooms are comfortable for 2-3 people, food available in the mess as well as canteen is healthy and also tasty, emergency first aid is also available, No proper playground is available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Moderate faculty, decent placements for CS IT and above average for EXTC. Decent infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. The library and classrooms are well-maintained. The hostel has different types of sharing rooms like 3 students, 5 students, and 7 students. The hostel has air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms. The warden is very understanding.

VESIT offers the following Scholarships to meritorious and needy students:

1) Students Aid Scholarship :The criteria for this scholarship is that the student should have a score of at least 7.00 grade and family income of less than one Lacs per annum. Scholarships of Rupees Fifteen thousand each are given to 25-30 students across all departments every year.

2) Vivekanand Jyoti Scholarship :One meritorious student from each department is given this scholarship. An Amount of Rupees Twenty five thousand each is given every year. The criteria is a grade point of at least 7.00 and family Income of less than one Lacs per annum.
3) Sahayog Scholarship :This is a scholarship by the students for the students. Any fund collected by students is used to fund one or more students.

individual_reviews.title: A good college in Navi Mumbai with quite less fees and decent placement.

content.Placements: I have heard from seniors that here we have around 4-5 LPA as the average package, and 8-10 LPA is the highest from my branch. content.Infrastructure: In the name of infrastructure, we just have 3 buildings, and even in that, 1 is under construction. placement_data.title: Datta Meghe College of Engineering Placement overview
paragraphs: DMCE has an active Training & Placement (T&P) cell that makes efforts to develop and strengthen the relationship with the corporate world. The cell works round the year to liaison with major organisations. Apart from this, the cell is also responsible for facilitating training, arranging live projects, arranging personality development sessions, initiating campus recruitment programmes and providing placement assistance to the students. This is the reason that DMCE has been recording phenomenal placement statistics over the years and each year is surpassing previous year's records.
DMCE recently completed its placements season for 2021 batch. A few interesting highlights of DMCE placements 2021 are enlisted below:

reviews.review_heading: A good college in Navi Mumbai with quite less fees and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: In the name of infrastructure, we just have 3 buildings, and even in that, 1 is under construction. We have 1 building of 11 floors for tech branches (Comp, IT, AI/ML, EXTC) and another new building for Civil, Infra, and Mechanical branches. We get decent facilities like Wi-Fi in the library. The canteen is quite decent, but this college doesn't have its own ground, that's an issue here. We just have a badminton court in the main building, and that's it.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Datta Meghe College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The campus is average. The infrastructure is not too good for first-year students. Wi-Fi is available with a good connection. Classrooms are big, so 70 students can sit comfortably. The library is too big with Wi-Fi connection, and books are well managed. The canteen is average because it is under construction. Medical facilities are available. Badminton club, cricket, and football clubs are also available. This college is not too focused on sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DMCE in brief.
reviews.review_text: There are spacious buildings, well-equipped labs, a large library, Wi-Fi campus (just for study), and decent classrooms. Library is good. It has good collection of books. There are no hostels or sporting grounds, which are the two drawbacks students faced, other than that, there are no issues.

reviews.review_heading: Great staff. They are supportive and helpful.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is like average. Labs and classrooms are decent. Quality of food is like okay. About hostel I have learned its fine. The campus is quite good. The infrastructure is also fine with a great vibe. Working facilities like lift are available. There are fresh seats, and a badminton court is available.

reviews.review_heading: Top choice for civil engineering at Mumbai University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has two buildings and a third under construction, which will soon be working with a single Building, specially for coal branches like civil. We have multiple labs for practicals with excellent classrooms. A library and Wi-Fi are available. We also have a canteen, and for sports we have a badminton court. Currently, our college does not provide hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Best choice for 90-95% CET score students.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are provided by college management for all branches. Since we are talking about information technology, I will narrate my experience. For IT students, all types of labs are provided I mean whatever you will need for studying is available however its quality is not exactly excellent but it works. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the campus and it works fine. Library contains books for all departments and subjects and its very huge and quite so you won't have any problems while studyin...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Datta Meghe College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are very good in the college. Wi-Fi is available. Labs are proper. We have well-maintained classrooms. Library is also well-maintained. There is no hostel in the college. We have to take PG outside of the college. College has canteen facilities and the food is average. They conduct sports and games. They also have a medical room.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is really good and staff is really helpful. Placements are good too.
reviews.review_text: Well, there are no official hostels for this college. But there are many PGs that are available nearby. Also, there are many different cities nearby, so students may live there too as they get a connected railway line which is just 2 minutes away from this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students from Kalyan Dombivli, Thane.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. The college library has ample copies of every book relevant to the course and it also has Wi-Fi. Washrooms are really clean. There is no ground on campus but a badminton court is available. The college has a canteen too.

reviews.review_heading: A deep drive into the pros and cons of Data Meghe College of Engineering (DMCE), Airoli.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available include a badminton court and a sports room with equipment for indoor games. The college does not provide hostel facilities, so students who do not live in Mumbai prefer to stay in PGs or rental rooms. There is a canteen in the college, but the quality of the food can be improved. The classrooms are good, and the equipment in the lab is well-stocked.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, satisfied with the college, faculty loved the college, placements are moreover good.
reviews.review_text: There is a big library and gym is also there. Many other sports activities are there. There is a badminton court. Canteen is also there and various sports activities are conducted. Ground is also available for sports like cricket, football, and various sports. They also organise gaming events.

reviews.review_heading: Not the best, but a college is a college!
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs do not have ACs, the library doesn't have really good books. The canteen is really small and messy. No sports and games can be held in college due to very small space. It has no hostel; the only time the college goes under maintenance is before the NAAC visit.

reviews.review_heading: Review about my college DMCE.
reviews.review_text: The labs are well-maintained with proper arrangements and PCs, which makes it easy for students. The library has various books; even students are provided with Wi-Fi all over the college. The mess is not that great but can be said to be average, and sports are limited, while medical facilities are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Average teachers, decent placement, below-average campus. Overall, an average college.
reviews.review_text: The college doesn't have any hostels. However, there are many PGs near the college. I guess the rent there is 5-7k, so I don't have much idea. Messes are also decent. I am a day scholar, so I don't have much idea about the hostel and mess. And talking about infrastructure, it is average; the college infrastructure is good, but it lacks play areas and a campus where students can chill. Otherwise, it's nice.

reviews.review_heading: A good decent college with good placement .
reviews.review_text:
No hostel facility available but you can take PG near college my course lab is well maintained Electronics and telecommunication lab. Canteen is also good
And there is gym and badminton court and game room with carrom and chess gym also his equipped with good machines .

reviews.review_heading: MGM has good infrastructure with affordable fees.
reviews.review_text: MGM College has a huge campus in Navi Mumbai. The college building is fully white and has a huge campus. There are 7 to 8 computer labs only for CS students, and one floor is booked only for the EXTC department. The college has good entrance through GATE and has 5 floors, while civil and mechanical departments have 2 floors in a different building. The college has two canteens on campus and one cafe. There is also a basketball court and a cricket playground in the college campus.

reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available everywhere. We have 2 canteens 1 central canteen and 1 entrance canteen. There is also a cafe called Poshan and a CCD network. reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure. The red-colored building looks attractive. Wi-Fi, bus facilities, labs, and the library are available for students. Separate hostels for girls and boys are available. The mess provides decent-quality food, and the café and canteen offer good food items. An emergency medical team is present in the college. Sports and games events are organized regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good, and their approach to teaching is also good.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were provided with either 3 seaters or 4 seaters. The architecture students were sometimes provided with 2 seaters as they require the room. We had 4 wings for all 4 years. First year students were in a separate hostel then 2nd, 3rd, and 4th. We had wings in the hostel area. Water coolers were provided. Wi-Fi was also provided.

reviews.review_heading: In CS and its related branches, the average package is 3-5 LPA.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good here. There are proper labs and everything for students. The Bajaj group and clubs are here for innovation and making something new. review_summary.college_name: Atharva College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review of Atharva College of Engineering, The Atharva Educational Trust.

content.Placements: Placement in our college is decent. As seen, mostly 80% students are placed by the end of the course. As usual, the CE and IT branches usually get higher packages. The average package range is around 4-5 LPA in our branch. The highest package can go up to around 12-15 LPA in some cases. Top recruiters include TCS, Capgemini, Infosys, Byju's, Accenture, Local Startups, etc. Most of the companies offer roles like Software Development, Web Developer, QA Engineer, etc. At the end, it all comes down to your skills and patience to grab the best of the packages.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure and the faculty members. The college has good placements.

content.Placements: 80% of students are placed. The highest package is 12-24 LPA. Many top telecom companies offered internships and jobs to some of the students. The lowest package could be approximately 3-5 LPA. Companies like Amazon, Godrej, Infosys, Infotech, etc., recruit.
content.Infrastructure: They provide everything, labs, classrooms, a separate girls' room, playground, even canteens and cafes. The infrastructure is really good, and the washrooms are kept very clean for both the students and the faculty members. We have washrooms on the ground floor, 1st floor,3rd, 4th and 5th floors.

individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with moderate placements.

content.Placements: I am from the 2026 passing out batch of Computer Engineering. 75 to 80 percent of students from my course are placed through campus recruitment. The highest package offered is 12 to 14LPA the lowest package offered is 2.8 to 3LPA and the average pacakge offered is 5 to 5.5LPA.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure and facilities go well.

content.Placements: Around 70-85 percent of students from our batch are placed. The highest package offered is around 10 LPA-12 LPA, the average is around 4 LPA-5 LPA, and the lowest is around 2.5 LPA-3 LPA. The major recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, Capgemini, and a few startups. Around 40-60 percent of students got internships mostly through companies like TCS, Byju's, local startups, and on-campus drives. The top roles offered are Software Developer, Data Analyst, System Engineer, Support Engineer, and Intern-Trainee roles.
content.Infrastructure: The course infrastructure is quite good. Our classrooms are equipped with projectors, and the department has well-maintained computer labs, Wi-Fi, and a decent library with good book availability. Hostel facilities are average. Rooms are clean but Wi-Fi speed varies. The mess food is moderate, with limited variety but hygienic. Medical facilities are basic and sports facilities include a ground, indoor games, and a small gym.

faqs.answer: Candidates must have BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, or MSc in a related field with aggregate marks of 50% and above (45% for SC/ST, OBC/Other categories) and must be qualified in TANCET / GATE for admission. Direct admission to TANCA Counselling is available to candidates with a valid GATE score.

faqs.question: Is KCG College of Technology hard to get?
faqs.answer: KCG College of Technology is not very difficult to get admission to, if the candidates are able to secure a minimum aggregate of 45% in Class 12, for courses such as BTech. Whereas, for courses such as MTech, candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 50% in graduation. Moreover, candidates must qualify entrance exams such as TNEA, TANCET or other equivalent exams. Candidates can apply for admission online through the official website for the same and enrol for candidature.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admissions to M.Tech courses at KCG College of Technology?
faqs.answer: The eligibility requirements for the MTech/ ME course are that students should complete the BTech/ BE degree in a stream relevant to applying ME course with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Also, for selecting the students, the college considers an acceptable score of PG entrance exam, i.e., GATE or CEETA.

faqs.question: How to get admission at KCG College of Technology?
faqs.answer: Admission to KCG College of Technology is granted through a valid TNEA score for BTech and TANCET score for MTech. Applications can be submitted online. The completed form and documents are then to be sent through post. Based on merit, shortlisted candidates attend counseling and final selections are made through a cumulative score. Admission is confirmed after payment of the required fees.

faqs.question: What are the courses offered at KCG College of Technology?
faqs.answer: KCG College of Technology offers BTech in computer science, mechanical, civil, and electronics disciplines. Admissions are made through TNEA scores. M.Tech programs include specializations such as structural engineering and power electronics. Admissions are based on TANCET scores. PhD programmes in Engineering and Technology are offered according to Anna University norms, and a written test and interview form part of the selection process.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in KCGCT without TNEA?
faqs.answer: Admission to KCG College of Technology for undergraduate programmes is normally based on valid TNEA score as it is the major selection criterion. For postgraduate programs like MTech, a valid TANCET score is required. Direct admission without TNEA or TANCET may not be possible unless mentioned under a management quota or other special admission policies, if any.

faqs.question: What are the minimum marks required to get a seat at KCG College of Technology?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have completed the 10+2 programme with at least 45% in the required courses of physics, math, and chemistry for taking admission in KCG College of Technology. Candidates must have earned at least 45% in math, physics, or chemistry in their vocational theoretical and practical exams for KCG College of Technology. To be considered, applicants must pass the TNEA admission test.

paragraphs: The admission proces for Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) can be completed online. Students need to go through application, selection, and admission confirmation. Students who are interested in joining the institute can follow the steps below to complete theQuantum School of Technology (Admission Office) admission process:
Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) Application Process 2026

The admission process starts with filling Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) course admissions application form. Interested candidates can visit the official website to apply for the course of their choice along with making an application fee for the respective courses.
Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) Selection Process 2026

The selection process at Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) is merit + entrance-based. Students need to submit scores of the last qualifying exams (Class 12 for UG & Graduation for PG admissions).

Students also need to appear for the Q-CARE exam - which is an entrance-cum-scholarship exam. Students can also submit valid scores of national-level exams, such as JEE Main (BTech) or CAT/ XAT for MBA. For more course-wise selection procedures students can visit the official website.
Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) Admission Confirmation 2026
After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called for verification of the documents. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.
Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) Fees 2026

Quantum School of Technology (Admission Office) fee structureincludes tuition fee, library fee, caution deposit, and more. Some of these are charged only once. review_summary.college_name: Sandip University Nashik Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Many reputed companies came here. More than 80 percent of students were placed last year from my course. The highest package was not disclosed yet, and recruiting companies like IBM, Infosys, Accenture, etc., came here for recruitment and got a good placement.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very awesome at Sandip University. It is located in Nashik, and the climate is very good. It always rains there. The hostel is good; there are 4-sharing rooms, and 2-sharing rooms are also available. There are also 4 messes. Veg and non-veg options are available here.

individual_reviews.course: BBA LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, balanced law and management course, good facilities, and vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: The BBA LLB (Hons) course at Sandip University offers decent placement opportunities. Around 65-75% of students get placed each year. The highest package ranges from 7 LPA to 8 LPA, the lowest is around 3 LPA, and the average stands at 4.5 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiters include corporate firms like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, as well as law firms and consulting companies like Deloitte and KPMG. Nearly 80-90% of students secure internships in courts, law firms, NGOs, and corporate houses. Common roles offered are legal associate, corporate legal executive, compliance analyst, HR or business analyst, and litigation intern, ensuring a diverse career path.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is moderately good, with average-quality education.

content.Placements: Only 15% of students are placed in my college. The highest package is 8.4 LPA, the lowest is 2.4 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Mahindra and Tata Motors. Only 20% of students got internships. The top roles include mechanical engineering designer.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are well-maintained. The labs have equipment, but most of it is not working. The Wi-Fi is not too bad. The library has good enough books. The hostel facilities are basic, with basic furniture. The food is always available but does not taste too good. There are a lot of canteens available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: All the above is true, and you can take admission if you want to.

content.Placements: The pass students are placed. 3-4 students got placed in last year. The highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA to 4 LPA. There are many companies like Bosch, Mahindra, Infosys, etc. Around 30 to 40 students are placed in my college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure available for our course department is very good. The infrastructure is very well-maintained. There are labs, libraries, and ground. Quality of food and other facilities is available. Overall, it is good.
content.Faculty: Teachers are really helpful, good, qualified, and knowledgeable. They provide little bite quality. It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are not that much difficult. But the proper guidance and proper study can beat it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Sandip University- Gate way of dream life.

content.Placements: Placements are good. They have a job fair for everyone. Where students across all cities are called. Multiple companies come here. Apart from job fairs, there are campus placements twice a year. Also, they provide internships to know the industry well. Also, students are asked to give mock interviews in college.
content.Infrastructure: It has state-of-the-art infrastructure. Huge campus of 274 acres which can accommodate large crowds. Overall there are too many facilities on campus. Sports complex which has football ground, cricket ground, and badminton court with basketball and tennis court. It also has multiple canteens and food courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Pretty satisfied with the college, knew what I was getting into. Campus life could be better.

content.Placements: About 70% of the students got placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA. The highest salary is around 16 LPA - 18 LPA. Top recruiters are Godrej and TCS. Internships are compulsory for every student in 3rd or 4th year. The college is now offering B.Tech instead of BE since it just got autonomous status.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are really good. Hostels are pretty good too. All the branches have a lot of labs with really good equipment. Wi-Fi isn't available for students but the PCs have it. The quality of the food in the canteen is top-notch without a doubt.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average College with No Student Life.

content.Placements: Mechanical had an average placement according to them, but it's really low and has a really less package. They give paid internships through the college this semester, and final years have some internship possibilities. But during the semester break, if you get an internship offer during the semester, they won't allow you and don't provide the internship letter. They cut your attendance and exams.
content.Infrastructure: There's no Wi-Fi facility available at all in the college for students. The library is strict and has poor infrastructure. There's a multimedia section with computers, but they are so old and outdated that they won't even start within 15 minutes. Doing the work takes 2 hours on them. The hostel is too strict for everyone, and the boys' hostel is still okayish, but the girls' hostel and hostel warden are like a switch for them.

reviews.review_heading: I would rate it 4 for all the things like placement, campus and all.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms are also decent, but the auditorium hall is small according to the college and the number of students. The hostel is very good. Security and cleanliness are well maintained, but the mess is not that good. For events and sports, the college is very active. Many cultural events and sports tournaments of BGMI-like games happen on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I would rate it 3 out of 5. I am quite satisfied on a percentile basis.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms are also decent, but the auditorium hall is small according to the college and the number of students. The hostel is very good. Security and cleanliness are good in the hostel. The mess is not that good. The college hosts many cultural events and sports tournaments of BGMI, as game downloads happen on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Ajeenkya DY Patil College offers a good balance of academics, infrastructure, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Mechanical department has well-equipped labs, modern classrooms with smart boards, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a good central library with updated resources. Hostel rooms are clean and comfortable, with 24X7 security and Wi-Fi. Mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen offers decent variety. Medical facilities are available on campus. Sports grounds are well-maintained with options for cricket, football, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is excellent, but it needs to work in the sports department.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great and all the facilities are provided, like 24-hour Wi-Fi connection, 24-hour water supply, and electricity to all the classes on all the campuses. Mess is also decent, but there needs to be work done in the sports department, the medical field, and the parking area.

reviews.review_heading: Good college environment and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Labs are provided with new instruments and technology. The handling of instruments is good. Expert teachers are available at the college for practicals. The quality of food in the college canteen is very good and in average amount. The hostels are clean, and security is very good.

reviews.review_heading: About Ajeenkya DY Patil value for money. Provides good teachers and spacious campus.
reviews.review_text: I have positive reviews for its infrastructure, highlighting a well-maintained, spacious campus with good facilities, including a library, sports courts, well-equipped classrooms, cafeteria, and labs. It provides good facilities in hostel. All basic needs are there. Each hostel room has different price.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available in our college. Classrooms are well-maintained and campus is clean. College is very good and well-maintained. Infrastructure of the college is also good.

reviews.review_heading: The Biggest and Best Campus in Pune.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is so nice; various facilities are provided, like Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms for every department. The library is also big and has all the required literature. The hostel is also good, and the food quality is superb. Different sports playgrounds are present.

reviews.review_heading: Quite average in everything. Placements are very poor and faculty is not at all helpful.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides essential amenities such as WiFi, well-equipped labs, modern classrooms, and a library. However, the overall quality of these facilities can be considered average, with room for improvement in certain areas to enhance the student experience.

reviews.review_heading: My experience of Ajeenkya.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college for our courses are very good. For example, they provide Wi-Fi and a library, which opens at 8 o'clock in the morning. The classrooms also have LED screens for a better understanding of concepts and topics. They also provide filtered drinking water.

reviews.review_heading: My college. My experience .
reviews.review_text: The course in electronics and telecommunications is studied well in this college and the faculty also have great teaching experience and a very supportive staff. The hostel of this college has all facilities like hostel mess, laundry, neat cleaning and many other facilities .

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely value for money and value for education.
reviews.review_text: We have good quality classrooms, labs, and a big central library with Wi-Fi throughout the campus of good quality bandwidth. The hostels are also of good quality, with spacious rooms and ventilation, but the mess and canteen don't have a great food taste.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of placements, satisfied with the environment.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities like Wi-Fi, Library, Workshop, Sports Club, and multiple grounds. But this is not enough in today's modern world; at least smart classrooms must be there. Smart classrooms, smart boards, and ACs are lacking here. There is a canteen in our hostel named D'cafe, and the quality is great, but the food is costly.

reviews.review_heading: Bright future in Ajeenkya DY Patil School of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and the campus are very good. Campus has a futuristic and very naturistic environment. Hostel life is also very nice, and the quality of facilities is also good. Mess and canteen are very maintained, every day it has been cleaned. Overall, infrastructure of our course and hostel is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, good infrastructure, excellent campus, and room for academic improvement.
reviews.review_text: College provides Wi-Fi facilities on every floor of its building and has many labs which help students a lot. Classrooms are also big and clean. The library also has a lot of books which are enough for all the subjects and it also has a digital library. As a day scholar. I don't have much idea about hostels and all.
